Two Swimming Lesson Options

Splash Academy runs group lessons of up to eight children on Saturday mornings. A ten-week course costs 85 pounds.

Blue Wave Swim School runs smaller groups of up to four children on weekday afternoons. A ten-week course costs 120 pounds.

Both schools use qualified instructors and assess children in the first lesson. Blue Wave also offers a free trial lesson.
